name: Octaware Technologies Limited
summary: Octaware Technologies Ltd. operates as an information technology firm, specializing in the design, development, and ongoing maintenance of diverse software solutions and systems. The company provides its IT expertise to a wide array of industries, including healthcare, education, telecommunications, energy (oil & gas), property development, financial services, and manufacturing. Its extensive suite of services encompasses bespoke software creation, enterprise portal development, implementation of ERP and CRM platforms, mobile applications, radio frequency identification (RFID) solutions, alongside offerings in cloud, security, and IT infrastructure management. Additionally, the firm delivers strategic consulting and geospatial services. Established by Mohammed Aslam Khan on May 26, 2005, Octaware Technologies is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
